test_case_name: Accept All Cookies on Deposito Oro Page

intents.intent: Click 'Acconsento' on the Deposito oro page
And then check that all cookies are accepted and the cookie banner is dismissed

test_case_name: Open Cookie Policy Options from Deposito Oro Page

intents.intent: Click 'Più opzioni' on the Deposito oro page
And then check that the Privacy - Cookie policy page is displayed
